in_marathi.name: Shub
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shub हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shub is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shubh' which means auspicious, well-being, prosperity, happiness, and good fortune. It is a popular name among Hindus and is believed to bring blessings and success in life.
